note: Production Rive scene (tools/rebuild/build.sh). Every layer is cut from source-nomi-master.png (body alpha normalised into reference/svg-layered/mother-v2.png); hidden areas are painted procedurally from the same part's own mother pixels. Closed eyes are cut from reference/sheets/nomi-sheet-parts.png (official sheet); blush and the fist sprites are procedural from mother pixels. No third-party pixels.

source-nomi-master.png.method: user supplied full-body mother (embedded byte for byte as the source lock)

reference/svg-rig/nomi-fullbody-mother.s.method: byte-exact SVG wrapper of the mother (embedded as a blob)
